# Journal of Clinical Investigation

> > The Journal of Clinical Investigation is a peer-reviewed biomedical research journal publishing clinical investigations, reviews, and video content across multiple medical specialties.

JCI and its companion publication JCI Insight serve as premier outlets for clinical and translational research, featuring editorial leadership, author resources, and multimedia content on topics ranging from neurodegeneration and cancer to metabolic diseases. The journal is affiliated with the American Society for Clinical Investigation (ASCI) and maintains rigorous publication ethics standards.

## Journal Homepages

- [JCI - Welcome](https://www.jci.org): Journal of Clinical Investigation homepage with peer-reviewed biomedical research
- [JCI Insight - Welcome](http://insight.jci.org): JCI Insight journal homepage featuring clinical research and biomedical articles
- [JCI - Current Issue](https://www.jci.org/current): Current journal issue with articles on atherosclerosis and neurodegeneration

## About & Editorial Leadership

- [JCI - About the Journal of Clinical Investigation](https://www.jci.org/kiosks/about): About page covering JCI mission, policies, and impact factor information
- [JCI - Editorial Board](https://www.jci.org/kiosks/editorial-board): Editorial board members including Elizabeth McNally and Hossein Ardehali
- [JCI - Consulting Editors](https://www.jci.org/kiosks/about/consulting-editors): Consulting editors from Duke, UCLA, Johns Hopkins and other institutions

## Author Resources & Guidelines

- [JCI - Author Information Center](https://www.jci.org/kiosks/authors): Author guidelines covering manuscript submission and open-access policies
- [JCI - Publication Ethics](https://www.jci.org/kiosks/ethics): Publication ethics guidelines including peer review and misconduct policies

## Research Content & Reviews

- [JCI - Research Specialties Directory](https://www.jci.org/specialties): Directory of research specialties and medical topics covered by JCI
- [JCI - Review Series: Neurodegeneration & Alzheimer's](https://www.jci.org/review_series/135): Review series on neurodegeneration, Alzheimer's prevention, and ALS-FTD
- [JCI - Review Series: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists](https://www.jci.org/review_series/134): Review series on GLP-1 receptor agonists for diabetes and obesity treatment
- [JCI - Review Series: Pancreatic Cancer](https://www.jci.org/review_series/133): Review series on pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma biology and detection

## Multimedia & Educational Content

- [JCI - Videos](https://www.jci.org/videos): Video content including ASCI milestone awards and research presentations
- [JCI - Video Abstracts](https://www.jci.org/videos/video_abstracts): Author video abstracts presenting peer-reviewed research findings
- [JCI - Conversations with Giants in Medicine](https://www.jci.org/videos/cgms): Interview series with medical leaders and Nobel laureates on scientific discovery
- [JCI - ASCI Milestone Awards](https://www.jci.org/videos/asci_milestone_awards): ASCI milestone award recipients and clinical investigation honors
